findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: query_events, list_alert_channels · Private data: query_costs, query_usage, list_alert_channels · Public sink: list_cost_tags, list_anomalies, query_unit_costs, list_alert_channels, list_alert_deliveries · Destructive: list_savings_recommendations, list_anomalies, list_data_health, list_cost_tag_rules.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: query_events, list_alert_channels · Private data: query_costs, query_usage, list_alert_channels · Public sink: list_cost_tags, list_anomalies, query_unit_costs, list_alert_channels, list_alert_deliveries · Destructive: list_savings_recommendations, list_anomalies, list_data_health, list_cost_tag_rules

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
